idea-plugin.name: GitMemo
idea-plugin.description:
View, add, edit and delete git notes on commits, from the VCS Log.

Git notes attach text to a commit that already exists, without rewriting it. The IDE does not display them anywhere by default. This plugin makes them part of the Log:

  • a note indicator in the commit details panel, showing the note as its tooltip and opening an editor when clicked;
  • a Git Notes tool window that follows the Log selection and edits notes inline;
  • a Notes group in the Log context menu to edit, delete or copy a note, and to fetch and push the notes refs;
  • Send to Claude Code, which types a note into a Claude Code terminal session as context and leaves it unsent for you to review;
  • a configurable notes namespace, so notes can be kept under refs/notes/review or any other ref.

One use is recording why a change was made when a coding agent produced the commit. Handoff notes, constraints and the session reference live on the commit itself, so they stay in the history and can be shared with the rest of the team.

Requires a local git executable; git reached through WSL or Docker is not supported. Send to Claude Code additionally requires the Terminal plugin.
